title: The Colts sealed their fate with the 2023 NFL draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The Colts sealed their fate with the 2023 NFL draft
sources.description: Fate isn’t necessarily good or bad. It’s a word that goes both ways, but what the Indianapolis Colts did in 2023 sealed theirs for the foreseeable future and unfortunately, it isn’t the good kind of fate. Selecting Anthony Richardson fourth overall is shaping the future in ways unknown. It could all work out in the […]
